manifest.title: Niche Sprint v1
manifest.subtitle: 6 low-tier models · 10 one-shot challenges
manifest.description: A fixed mixed challenge across procedural reasoning, extract-from-text, HTML contracts, constraint bursts, and JSON schema. Same tasks for every model. Zero context harness. Run via AIML API — model IDs verified against /v1/models (June 2026).

runs.task_prompt: You are standing facing south. You turn left, turn left, then turn left. What direction are you now facing? Answer with one word only: north, east, south, or west.

What is the next number in this sequence? Output only the number, nothing else.

16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?
If today is Friday, what day of the week will it be in exactly 53 days? Answer with just the day name.
Is "level" a palindrome? Answer with only "yes" or "no".
